IS 5022 : 1989 Sterilizer, Instruments, Table ModelUDC 615.478.73MHD14Reaffirmed 20191 Scope1.1 This standard covers structural and functional requirements of boiling type table model instruments sterilizer for disinfecting different types of instruments used in clinics and hospitals.1.2 Only the sterilizers which are used in places other than the anaesthetic-gas atmosphere come under the purview of this standard.1.3 This method does not give sterility since spores are not necessarily killed in the process. The method is, however, satisfactory for most general disinfection.2 ReferencesIS 302 : 1979 General and safety requirements for household and similar electrical appliancesIS 1342 : 1986Oil pressure stovesIS 2787 : 1986Multi-burners oil pressure stovesIS 4159 : 1983Mineral filled sheathed heating elementsIS 4827 : 1983 Electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on copper and copper alloysIS 4905 : 1968Methods for random samplingIS 6911 : 1972Stainless steel plate sheet and strip
